notes.title: Update 1.2 New Power-Ups, Rooms, and Improvements to Secrets
notes.notes:
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44535569/117cd3eb454177a79e9bb9ac38590bfd344bcc86.png"]

Thank you for your support, feedback, and comments! We are very excited and dedicated to making the game better with each update.


Changelog 1.2
Improvements and fixes:

-  Added 6 new power-ups; one is available from the start, the others unlock under various conditions.

- Starting rooms in underground stations and open areas now have additional variations.

- Improved weapon firing visual effects. Fixed a bug that caused bullet impact marks to rarely appear on surfaces.

- Better loot will now spawn more often in secret rooms.

- When oxygen is depleted, a message will now be displayed informing you that you are taking damage from it, for clarity.

- During run, auto-pickup settings are now visible in the menu but cannot be changed, so players know they can be adjusted in the Main menu.

- Mannequins now respawn after being destroyed.

- Fixed a bug that prevented using the shop when playing with a gamepad.

- Fixed a bug where menu actions would trigger while rebinding keys.

notes.title: Update 1.1 Cloud saves and other improvements
notes.notes:
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44535569/6ac1c11f3cbfe0ead5c73169aa6c2dcf6f60efce.png"]


Thank you for your support, feedback, and comments! We are very excited and dedicated to making the game better with each update.


Changelog 1.1

Improvements and fixes:
- Added support for cloud saves.  

- Added a hint about the Mega-Weapon that will appear when you collect the first part of the recipe. The old hint that appeared during the transformation of the Mega-Weapon has been removed.  

- The longest path in the first biome will now contain fewer levels.  

- The Laboratory in the Hub now unlocks slightly earlier.  

- Improved hit detection for melee weapons.  

- Enhanced the stealth aspect of the game: Reduced the hearing range of monsters and overall alertness. Slightly reduced the view angle and distance for some monsters. Reduced the recognition radius when approaching monsters from behind. Mini-bosses remain unchanged; they hear, see, and react as before.  

- Slightly reduced the attack radius of long-range monsters.  

- Mini-bosses now drop loot more frequently.  

- More equipment and upgrades are now unlocked initially, and unlocking new ones takes slightly less time.  

- Increased the explosion radius of barrels and their damage to monsters (damage to players remains unchanged).  

- In the Underground Research Station, Small Station in the Canyon, and Medical Laboratory, Credits can now be found more frequently.  

- Fixed a bug where items that had not yet been unlocked were displayed in the shop and were not issued upon purchase.  

- Fixed a bug where fewer keycards than intended could appear in the Reactor level.  

- Additional optimization for Low graphic quality.

notes.title: Ammo and Oxygen has been released! Update 1.0
notes.notes:
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44535569/32b29e4e8fa491370486d7a5d1a1ee062347b337.png"]

Thanks to you, we have come this far, and Ammo and Oxygen have been released!



Get the game for a 20% discount until September 14th on Steam:  

[dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/2549650/"][/dynamiclink]

Thank you for your support, feedback, and comments! We are very excited and dedicated to making the game better with each update.

 
Changelog for Version 1.0

Changes and Improvements:
- Added the final level and story slides.

- Reduced the difficulty of the swamps, bunker, and medical laboratory.

- Increased the chances of finding shops and secret rooms in levels.

- Added a tutorial hint about the Fear effect and a hint regarding destructible objects.

- In cooperative mode, the icons for other active interactions are no longer hidden, as multiple players can interact with them simultaneously.

- Now, with the Delivery Service powerup, there will always be loot in the boxes.

- Now, when the ammo store is empty, a large icon indicating the absence of ammo will also be displayed in the current weapon section.

- Added black-yellow stripes and green arrows to improve the visibility of certain obstacles and passages.

- Updated and enhanced the sound effects for monsters and the interface windows.

- Improved the display of shields on monsters with the corresponding ability.

- Enhanced the shop interface for better clarity.

- Improved loading screen animations.

- Enhanced the biomass graphics on the reactor level floor.

- Improved optimization and stability of the game.

Fixes:
- Fixed bugs causing rare spawns to not appear in most underground levels.

- Fixed a bug preventing the new achievement for spending credits from functioning.

- Fixed a bug where keybindings were not saving in the game.

- Fixed a bug that caused training models in the shooting range to disappear.

- Fixed some passages and doorways where large monsters could become stuck.

- Fixed a bug where liquids were not appearing on certain floor surfaces.

- Fixed a bug where the icon for absence of ammo did not disappear when picking up ammo.

- Fixed a bug that caused a micro-pause during monster explosions.

- Fixed a bug in cooperative mode where the night could be skipped with dead players, as well as a bug where oxygen was only deducted from one player.

- Fixed a bug in cooperative gameplay where flashlights for other players did not turn off when changing levels, often leading to unnecessary battery drain during the day.

- Fixed a bug where the attracting monster would try to pull the wrong player in cooperative mode.

- Fixed a bug where the mini-boss of the small monster did not differ significantly from the regular version.

- Fixed issues related to objects and monsters having sounds that were too quiet or missing entirely.

- Fixed some bugs related to overlapping rooms.

- Fixed a bug where the stun radius for monsters in close combat was too large.

- Fixed a bug where the percent symbol was not displayed in the French version of the game.

- Fixed music transition issues.

- Fixed minor visual and collider bugs.

notes.title: Pre-release Update 0.95. Optimization improvements, important fixes, and more
notes.notes:
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44535569/79e163281639ee86412994240311f6e8d5e64421.png"]

On September 6, Ammo and Oxygen will transition from Early Access to full release. We decided to release this update earlier because it contains many important fixes.

We are continuing preparations for the release, and the next update will include the continuation of the story, the final level, as well as improvements and fixes.



Thank you for your support, feedback, and comments! We are very excited and dedicated to making the game better with each update.

Changes and Improvements:
- Monsters no longer push the player and other monsters while moving, only when they attack.

- Improved game optimization and stability.

- Several new achievements added, and outdated ones updated (not all can be obtained before release).

- When oxygen and health levels are low, the indicators now flash in the interface. The camera effect for low oxygen has been enhanced for better visibility.

- The Reactor Complex and Swamp levels are now slightly shorter and easier.

- Reduced the number of monsters' dependence on the number of players.

- Points of interest now appear more frequently in the swamps.

- The graphics of breakable boxes have been changed.

- The time-slowing power has been altered; it now extends the daylight portion of the day.

- New story notes have been added.

- The auto-open door distance has been reduced.

- The visual effect of the shield for the monster with the corresponding ability has been refined.

- A system for displaying composite story scenes has been implemented, which will be used in several final dialogues.

- You can now assign a key to switch weapons in the opposite direction on both gamepad and keyboard.

- Debug information regarding the game version and FPS is now hidden.


Fixes:
- Fixed a bug that caused players to get stuck during pushes.

- Fixed an issue where the game would slow down at some point, and the FPS would be locked at a low level.

- Fixed a bug that caused movement speed not to update at the beginning of a level until weapon switching.

- Fixed issues with grenades that caused them to deal no damage when fired rapidly. Decreased self-explosion damage.

- Fixed a bug that prevented rare object spawns on surface levels from appearing.

- Fixed an issue where large monsters would often get stuck in narrow passages.

- Fixed a bug that could cause in-game music to stop playing.

- Fixed a bug that allowed players to find secret rooms due to loot highlight icons.

- Fixed a bug where the first opening of the game menu had a noticeable delay.

- Fixed an issue where one of the story objects displayed incorrect texts.

- Fixed a bug that caused stationary monsters to visually sink into the ground.

- Fixed a bug where players could die from lack of oxygen when switching levels.

- Fixed an issue in cooperative mode where different players on the same selection screen could receive power-ups that could only be picked up once per session.

- Fixed a bug in cooperative mode where the low health and oxygen effects continued to display after a player's death. Other related bugs associated with these effects have also been fixed.

- Adjusted the exit zone sizes on levels, so in cooperative play, the prompt to press a key disappears when the active player moves away.

- Fixed an issue where button hints for the shop in cooperative mode displayed prompts for the player who opened the shop, even though only Player 1 could interact with it.

notes.title: Release date for version 1.0 and Launch Trailer
Major Update 0.9. Research Institute and new powerups
notes.notes:
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44535569/bd80811821f4a3edaa37feae414737e432f67430.png"]

Thank you for your support, feedback, and comments! We are very excited and dedicated to making the game better with each update.

Research Institute and Stories:
- In the Rocky Permafrost biome, an entrance to the Research Institute can now be found; this is the second-to-last level of the game.

- 9 new storyline notes have been added in the Swamp and Permafrost biomes.

New Powerups and Equipment:
- 8 new powerups have been added, 3 of which are related to energy weapons.

- 2 new pieces of equipment have been added.


Energy Weapons:
- Active time duration has been increased by 36%. Reload time has been increased fourfold.

- The BFG charge now accumulates faster, but damage has been slightly reduced.

- Explosions from the plasma gun now deal 25% damage to players, while damage to monsters remains unchanged. The fire rate has been slightly decreased.

- Damage from the energy machine gun has been reduced by 10%.

- Fixed a bug that caused the aberration effect to remain on the camera after the energy weapon's effects ended.

Other Changes and Improvements:
- More visual effects have been added to the station levels.

- Small physics objects can now be pushed more easily and obstruct movement less.

- Fixed a bug that caused explosive barrels to often explode on their own.

- Destructible objects now properly receive damage from different types of projectiles (grenades, projectiles flying through walls, etc.).

- Added sound effects for starting generators to obtain power.

- Fixed a bug in the Reactor Complex that could cause boxes to overlap in corridors, hindering movement.

- Fixed a bug where damage increase bonuses might not work on all weapons.

- Fixed issues with the localization of collectible items in the tutorial level.

- Fixed a bug that caused the entrance to the Bunker to appear in an inaccessible location in the swamp, and its icon on the mini-map was displayed in the wrong color.

- Fixed a bug that prevented the fear effect from being applied by the boss-version of the terrifying monster.

notes.title: Hotfix for Update 0.8.4
notes.notes:

- Fixed a bug that caused loot from breakable objects to appear in inaccessible places.

- Credits are now more frequently found in locked containers and tables.

notes.title: Major Update 0.8.4: Shops, Rocky Permafrost, Mini-Bosses, and more
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44535569/e62553b35e496db1f13c894e756204cfea6ba240.png

Thank you for your support, feedback, and comments! We are very excited and dedicated to making the game better with each update.

Automatic Shops:
- You can now find Credits in loot – the currency for local Shops. Credits do not persist between runs.
- In the outdoor levels, you'll encounter Automatic Shops where you can purchase ammo, gear, and other useful items for Credits. The offered items can be refreshed using a keycard. Some shops may appear disabled and will require a battery to activate.

Rocky Permafrost:
- A new biome, Rocky Permafrost, has been added. To access it, you need to get through the Medical Laboratory.
- You will encounter several new monsters in the levels of Rocky Permafrost.
- Later, mini-stations and the final level of the game will be added.

Mini-Bosses:
- There’s a small chance to encounter an enhanced version of regular monsters. These mini-bosses are larger, have different colors, and come with increased health and damage stats. Defeating such enemies can earn you extra DNA and loot, like power-ups or ammo.

Other Changes and Improvements:
- Four new power-ups and one new piece of gear have been added.
- Rare interesting objects and unusual spawn variations can now be found in levels.
- The interface now features subtle shadows on elements and fonts to improve readability in bright levels.
- Some non-plant objects obscuring the view now feature transparency.
- Navigation over small objects has been improved.
- The graphics of all breakable objects have been enhanced for easier visibility.
- Destructible objects in the later game levels have been fine-tuned.
- Fixed an issue that made it harder to hit breakable boxes.
- Fixed a bug where it was more dangerous during the day in the swamps than at night.
- Fixed an issue where unbreakable boxes and other objects that blocked passages could appear in levels.
- Adjusted the height of searches in a small room at the end of the Reactor Complex.

notes.title: Major Update 0.8.3: Destructible Objects and Secret Rooms
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44535569/524ed1a0074273693b4d6500fffab63f267a5777.png
Thank you for your support, feedback, and comments! We are very excited and dedicated to making the game better with each update.

Destructible Objects:
- Part of the environment is now interactive. You might encounter destructible alien eggs, barrels filled with explosive mixtures, cardboard boxes, and barrels of sticky fuel. They can either help you in battle or cause harm, serving as a source of loot or trouble.

Secret Rooms:
- Now some walls in the underground stations are destructible (you can identify them visually by cracks) and lead to small secret rooms. These rooms may hold extra loot, but be careful.

Other Improvements and Fixes:
- Now, if your weapon runs out of ammo, it is indicated by an icon on the weapon switch icons.
- New corridor variations have been added in the Reactor Complex.
- Fixed an issue that caused delays when switching to melee weapons.
- Fixed an issue where the mouse cursor sometimes wouldn't display after returning from the game to the main menu.

Boss in the Marshes and Online Co-op:
Unfortunately, the mechanics and limitations of the bosses do not currently meet our expectations and the interest we have placed in them. Therefore, we have decided to add them to the game after release in order to avoid delay with other content and the release date. Additionally, we must postpone online co-op for an indefinite period; this feature will not be available during Early Access. We would love to know if you are looking forward to online co-op.

Stay tuned for updates.

notes.title: Major Update 0.8.2: Library, new dungeon, co-op enhancements, and more
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44535569/e55ee8724e61c710928a70a3f3dddc285fc1c127.png

Thank you for your support and feedback! We are very inspired and committed to making the game better with every update.

New Dungeon:
- A new dungeon, the Medical Laboratory, has been added. This will be the final dungeon for the Toxic Swamps biome and the starting point for the Rocky Frost. This means that in the future, after beating this dungeon, you will be able to start new runs in the Medical Laboratory.
- In the Medical Laboratory, you might encounter a new monster that instills fear and causes rapid breathing in your character, so be careful with the monster and your oxygen supply!

Library:
- A new room, the Library, is now available in the Hub. Access can be obtained by collecting storyline entries. In the Library, you can see all collected notes and the number of uncollected ones. We plan to add similar sections for Weapons, Monsters, Equipment, and Enhancements in the future.
- Already viewed notes will no longer appear again in the levels.
- The Mystery counter has been removed.

Other Improvements:
- In cooperative play, each player can now perform their own personal actions with objects, independent of other players.
- Added a new monster: a small robot (a good source of spares). The robot will try to escape when it is spotted. It can appear on any level with a low chance, but only after unlocking (conditions are hidden).
- 7 new arts for story notes have been added.
- Visual enhancements with dynamics have been added to the station rooms and Canyon.
- The Reactor complex level is now slightly shorter.
- Additional basic weapons can now be found at all stations except the starting one, providing more options for collecting Mega-Weapon recipes.

Fixes:
- Fixed a bug that allowed characters to pass through certain objects, such as barrels, without obstruction.
- Fixed bugs that caused melee hits to have no visual effect.
- Fixed a bug where the "First Aid Knowledge" powerup did not fully restore health when picking up medkits.
- Fixed bugs in the Swamps and tutorial station levels.

Unfortunately, we were not able to fully finish the tuning and testing of the Swamp boss, so it will be included in the next update. Stay tuned for more news!

notes.title: Major Update 0.8: Residential Station, Melee Combat Changes, Power-ups, and more
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44535569/cb3530fa811aa322032fd6dea5f2126caf836032.png

Thank you for your support and feedback! We are very inspired and committed to making the game better with every update.

New Dungeon:
- Added a new dungeon: Residential Station. You can find the entrance in the Swamps, and a key card will be required to enter. As with other mini-dungeons, you can find upgrades, equipment, armor, ammunition, and oxygen here, as well as take shelter during the dark and skip the night. You can also discover a new secret and several storyline notes here.

New and Improved:
- You can now disable auto-pickup of weapons, ammunition, and other consumables in the settings from the main menu for both single-player and co-op modes.
- Now, when a gamepad is detected at the start of the game, you will be prompted to choose your control scheme.
- The melee combat system has been revamped. Now, during an attack, the character does not move, making fights with large monsters more challenging. You can now change the attack direction during a swing. The time between attacks has been reduced, and the attack range has been increased.
- Interaction icons have been differentiated to distinguish between searches, storyline notes, and others.
- Added 2 new power-ups, one of which is only available in cooperative mode.
- Added 2 new pieces of equipment.
- Batteries will now appear less frequently during searches, with more other consumables and medkits.
- Different combinations of creatures can now emerge from caves and monster lairs.
- Points of interest on the surface can now be found more frequently in the Swamps.
- The created mega-weapon now has more starting ammunition.
- Monster behavior in large areas has been optimized; they now fall asleep when far away.
- Movement with a shotgun now reduces shot spread less.
- The graphics of picked-up batteries have been changed to make them less confusing with oxygen tanks.

Fixes:
- Fixed a bug that caused animations to significantly affect shooting accuracy. For example, it was much harder to hit while moving backward (and this was not shown in the size of the reticle).
- Fixed a bug where the damage absorption shield of the monster was not functioning correctly (disappearing upon receiving any damage). Now, fighting it will be more challenging.
- Fixed some bugs that could cause rooms to end in a passage into emptiness.
- Fixed a bug with the generation of the Mining Station, which caused many large rooms to repeat one after another.
- Fixed a bug that blocked monster and loot spawns in the large open base in the Swamps.
- Fixed a bug preventing additional key cards from appearing in the Reactor Complex.
- Fixed a bug where reloading would trigger even with a full magazine.
- Fixed a bug where the recipe for the mega-SMG required a shotgun instead of an SMG.
- Fixed a bug with the limit on the number of rounds for inactive weapons, which sometimes led to a reduction in their quantity.
- Fixed the auto-exposure of the camera to be more sensitive to the onset of darkness (the flashlight might not have been visible for the first few seconds of the night).
- Fixed a bug where it was difficult to hit the monster summoning worms.
- Fixed a bug that could prevent the new level from loading during the day transition between levels, resulting in a black screen.
- Fixed a bug where the mega-pistol kill count would reset upon switching weapons.
- Fixed a bug where picking up the base weapon when the mega-weapon was assembled would cause it to be reassembled from scratch.
- Fixed places where players could climb high on rocks.
- Fixed several areas where players could exit beyond the canyon's boundaries.
- Fixed a bug where the reset progress window did not show gamepad button prompts and controls were not functional.
- Fixed a bug where the visual effect of low oxygen might not display.
- Fixed the firing sounds of the mega-revolver.

notes.title: Public testing - Experimental changes to melee combat
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44535569/524ed1a0074273693b4d6500fffab63f267a5777.png

Hello! Are there any other survivors here? Thank you for your support and feedback. 

We are working on update 0.8, which will include mini-dungeons in the Swamps, new power-ups and equipment, a variety of monsters in the lairs, and many other improvements. 

We are releasing a test version to gather feedback on the changes to melee combat.
What has changed: Movement is blocked during attacks, but you can change the direction of the attack after swinging. To compensate for the immobility, attacks occur more frequently, the hit area has been increased, and it responds better to moving targets. 

We want to hear your opinion on these experimental changes.

How to test: Select Ammo and Oxygen in your Steam library. Right-click -> Properties -> Betas -> Switch to development at the top right (you can switch back here whenever you want to use the main version of the game).
We recommend testing in English, as not all new locales have been added to the project.

Thank you! I hope this isn't anabiosis.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44535569/85b67e67d06e58553216fe562f2e6f14546a5d59.png

notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44535569/bc5ab240402fc81e585f8b5f6f6b20eb89896d53.png

Thanks to your feedback, we've added a lot of new content and made several changes.

Make sure to play the demo before June 17th on the Steam Next Fest
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2549650/

Add it to your wishlist to support us and not miss the game's release!

The demo features a solo mode and local co-op for up to 4 players. We'd be happy to hear your impressions, feedback, and suggestions.

Major Update 0.6.100

What's new:
- Illustrated tutorial tips have been added. Before starting the game, you can choose to either display the tips or skip them.
- A special icon is now displayed next to objects that can be interacted with.
- Tables and containers can now be inspected to search for loot.
- Key cards have been added. These are consumable items that will be required to open certain containers and doors.
- There will now be rooms with locked doors at stations, which can be opened by spending a key card. These rooms will always contain Equipment or Power-ups.
- Points of interest in the Canyon have been improved. New ones have been added, some objects are now searchable, and there are also places where monsters may appear when approached. Points of interest are now more frequent, and most of them can be found on the mini-map.
- The story recordings from the tutorial level are now also accessible in the Underground Research Station.
- Images have been added to the story window to better convey the atmosphere.
- Images have been added during the loading of the Hub level.
- The player control selection menu now displays device icons instead of lengthy text.
- Sound effects have been added to the story and upgrade windows.
- Katana and PipeSpike-3000 can now also be found at the Subterranean Research Station.
- A new option has been added in the settings to completely reset all current progress, including all collected memory fragments, weapons, currencies, and more.

Fixes and Improvements:
- Fixed a bug where the "Lottery" power-up could grant weapons that were not yet unlocked, causing them to disappear when stashed. The "Lottery" now includes all available weapon types.
- The worms spawned by the monster can now be attacked before they fully hatch.
- Melee attack animations and characteristics have been improved, and a bug that caused the animations to sometimes not play has been fixed.
- The physics of objects and their knockback by the player have been improved.
- Visual effects of hits, blood on the ground have been enhanced.
- Spawning in some large rooms of the Subterranean Research Station has been reworked, now there can be interesting loot as well as a slightly higher number of monsters.
- Progression of upgrade prices has been improved.
- The size of the exit icon on the mini-map has been fixed.
- Gamepad controls in the settings menu have been fixed.
- Bugs with controls that sometimes occurred after changing levels have been fixed.
- The story window can now also be closed with the mouse.
- Bugs that caused loot to sometimes appear in inaccessible places have been fixed.
- Some issues with doors and passages in the stations have been fixed.
- Bugs that could cause the player to get stuck in the Canyon or go out of bounds have been fixed.
- A bug that prevented the currency value in the UI from updating after a restart has been fixed.
- Now, during gameplay, when attempting to start over or quit, there will be a warning about what will be lost and what will be saved.
- A bug that caused some plants to be floating in the air has been fixed.
- A bug that caused rooms in the Subterranean Research Station to repeat has been fixed.
- Issues with the scorpion animations have been fixed.
- The sound effects for the Scorpion and Spider monsters have been changed.
- The movement speed with heavy weapons has been corrected.
- The font size in the info window has been fixed.
- A bug that could cause rooms to overlap has been fixed.
- Fixed a bug where the pipe and katana did not have the expected speed reduction effect when landing hits.
- Fixed issues that caused incorrect knockback effects when using melee weapons against enemies.
- Fixed a bug where the shotgun pickup would sometimes not be counted towards weapon unlocks.
- The detection radius of the Spawner monster has been increased.
- A bug has been fixed where unlocked fragments did not fit properly in the death screen window.
- A bug has been fixed where you could obtain an Augmentation in the safe zone immediately after changing days upon death.
- Story objects will now become inactive after being activated within a single run.
